cohort: 100 patients in labor at Lady Willingdon Hospital, Lahore.
finding: Cardiotocography (CTG) combined with fetal blood sampling for fetal blood pH is effective for assessing fetal condition in labor and deciding mode of delivery.
mod_finding: In the CTG only group, all patients had Cesarean sections, whereas in the CTG + fetal blood sampling group, 60% had Cesarean sections and 40% had vaginal deliveries.
